name: Handmade Upcycled Bicycle Chain and Vintage Keys Rustic Picture Frame (4x6)
description: An incredibly unique, artisan-crafted 4x6 picture frame made completely from upcycled real bicycle chains and welded vintage-style copper keys. This rustic, industrial piece features detailed craftsmanship where every link and key is meticulously joined by hand. Perfect statement decor for cycling enthusiasts, garage workshops, or industrial/loft-style living spaces. It comes in its original tissue wrapping and packing cardboard box, completely pristine and unused. Beautifully displays photos either horizontally or vertically with iron latches on the back. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a cat, though it has been stored safely in its packing box and remains in brand new condition.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled with durable built-in backing stand legs and glass pane insert. Since this is an unpadded structural decor item and doesn't feature an external fabric case, it does NOT come with an additional secondary retail storage bag. It is packed neatly in its protective eco-wrapping tissue and rustic corrugated cardboard backing box. Comes from a cat-friendly home, stored safely away from the pet.
meta_description: Unique handmade upcycled bicycle chain and vintage key picture frame. Fits 4x6 photos. Perfect rustic industrial gift for cyclists and eco-conscious decor [4].
name_zh: 手工环保利用 自行车链条与复古钥匙 工业风相框 (4x6寸)
